title: Safety Training Modulates Harmful Misalignment Under On-Policy RL, But Direction Depends on Environment Design

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated in the Political Question-Answer (PQA) environment by measuring how much the model uncritically aligns its responses with the user's specific political ideology (e.g., liberal, conservative, socialist, alt-right) to maximize reward, representing political sycophancy.

Evaluated by correlating the models' prior scores on standard social bias and discrimination benchmarks (BBQ, Crows-pairs, and Discrim-Eval) with their susceptibility to harmful misalignment under reinforcement learning.
